spans.s:
m. (-बः)
1 A rogue, a cheat.
2 An enemy.
f. (-वी)
Moonlight.
n. (-वं)
1 The white esculent water-lily.
2 Fraud, trick.
E.
केरव here said to mean, a goose, from के in water, and रु to sound, with अप् affix; again, अण् affix, liked by the geese; or किरव a cheat, &c. or कैरव a lotus, and अण् affix, implying identity or resemblance.

f. (-णी)
A place abounding in lotus flowers, or an assemblage of lotuses.
E.
कैरव a white lotus, इनि and ङीष् affs.

m. (-वी)
The moon.
E.
कैरवी moonlight, इनि aff.

m. (-कः)
A species of poison, one of the fixed kinds.

n. (-तं)
1 A sort of gentian, commonly Cherayta, (Gentiana cherayta, Rox.)
2 A kind of Sandal.
m. (-तः)
A strong man.
E.
किरात gentian, &c. अण् aff.
